::: {#def-venn-diagram}
#### Venn diagram
<!-- no-figure: @fig-venn-letters in @exm-venn-diagram, right after this definition, draws one -->

A **Venn diagram** draws sets as overlapping circles inside a rectangle
[@wikipedia_venn_diagram],
which stands for the set $S$ that the sets are subsets of, as in @def-complement.
Each region of the picture stands for the elements
that are in some of the sets and not in the others.

:::
